Name: Achievement Excluder
Author: Legolukas
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]Please read: If you choose to disable modded items, they will disappear from your collection tab. That is the only way, how the game handles the achievement.[/left]
[left]All features are disabled by default. Enable whatever you want in the settings! [b]You can only change settings in the title screen!![/b]! I'm using a whitelist feature, because that makes the most sense. So if you only want to block out 1 or a few mods, it might be a bit more work. I will improve this with future updates.[/left]
[center][/center]
[i]Customizable Collections[/i]: Filter items for the following tabs and achievements:
[list]
[*]  Shipping (Full Shipment)[/*]
[*]  Fishing (Master Angler)[/*]
[*]  Cooking (Gourmet Chef)[/*]
[*]  Minerals[/*]
[*]  Artifacts[/*]
[/list][i]Per-Mod Filtering[/i]: Easily toggle entire mods on or off. By default, all modded items are ignored so you can easily achieve perfection in heavily modded playthroughs without having to ship hundreds of modded items.

[i]Full Shipment Checker[/i]: [needs more testing] Makes game to re-check your shipment and fishing achievements every morning.

[i]Auto-Grant[/i]: [needs more testing] A built-in cheat option to automatically grant the Full Shipment achievement if you get stuck.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/center]

1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install Generic Mod Config Menu (highly recommended for easy configuration).
3. Download this mod and extract it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img][/center]

You can configure the mod directly in-game using the Generic Mod Config Menu (gear icon on the title screen or at the bottom of the in-game options menu).
Alternatively, you can manually edit the `config.json` file that is generated in the mod folder after running the game once.


[center][/center]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img][/center]
[left][/left]
[left]It's likely, that there will be some mod conflicts in the future or even now. For example the mod Animal Husbandry used Vanilla IDs, that exist technically, but are blocked in the vanilla game. Similar Situations could appear. Let me know if you encounter any. If certain items appear, add the specific item IDs to the `config.json` to exclude them.

[i]Mods[/i]:[/left]
[list]
[*]Animal Husbandry [solved ✅][/*]
[*]Dwarven Expansion [solved ✅][/*]
[/list]
